title: Grow a little, every day.
headline:
Grow a little,
every day.
scene: Cream backdrop, pale blue tabletop. Center-right original tiny smiling terracotta pot with a lush sculpted green sprout, a rounded lilac watering can tilts to release three clear clay water beads. One pink circular backdrop partially frames plant. Large dark-olive warm serif headline left. Soft matte ceramic-clay materials, tactile studio render, uncluttered playful composition.
